en: Sanborn Fire Insurance Map, Belford, Monmouth County, New Jersey, April 1924, Sheet 2
Sanborn Fire Insurance Map, Belford, Monmouth County, New Jersey, April 1924, Sheet 3
Sanborn Fire Insurance Map, Belford, Monmouth County, New Jersey, April 1924, Sheet 4, part 1 (main map)

sheet-2.description: Sheet 2 covers the western part of Belford in Middletown Township, between Church Street at the top and Main Street near the bottom, from the Woodland and Maple Drive area on the left to Morris Avenue on the right. It is drawn at 100 feet to an inch with north toward the upper right. Union Avenue, Park Avenue, Walling Avenue and Morris Avenue run between Church and Main, and Washington runs off diagonally south of Main. The blocks are divided into large numbered lots, mostly vacant, with scattered one and two storey frame dwellings, sheds and garages; houses are closest together along Walling Avenue and Morris Avenue, where a short street is marked as not opened. Cottage Place leads off Park Avenue, and a cemetery lies north of Church Street at the top left. South of Main Street the sheet is largely open land in large numbered blocks. A scale bar and the Belford title cartouche are printed in the corners.
notes: The Morris Avenue north of Church Street is today West Morris Avenue; the Morris Avenue between Church and Main keeps the name.
Church Street / Walling Avenue was left out: two modern nodes 20 m apart (Walling Avenue and West Morris Avenue) and a 5.7 m residual.
map, 100 ft. Church Street to Main Street, Union Avenue to Morris Avenue.

sheet-3.description: Sheet 3 covers central Belford between Church Street at the top and Main Street, with the open land south of Main toward East Road at the bottom right. It is drawn at 100 feet to an inch with north toward the upper right. Railroad Avenue crosses the sheet diagonally beside a railroad line, and Howard Avenue runs down the left side. East of the railroad, Campbell Avenue and Compton run from Church to Main, crossed by Park Place, Ridge Avenue and Lohsen Place, the last two marked as not improved. The First Methodist Episcopal Church stands on Church Street, and the public school is at the upper left. Dwellings line Church and Main Streets, and the interior blocks are largely vacant. At the bottom are the E. T. Bennett coal and wood yard by the railroad and, at the lower right, the Frank Anderson lumber yard beside another rail line. A scale bar and the Belford title cartouche are printed in the corners.
notes: Lohsen Place is today Lohsen Avenue; Compton is Compton Street.
Lohsen Avenue / Ridge Avenue (modern junction) was left out: a narrow pair, residual 5.6 m, and the 1924 streets do not meet there.
Campbell Avenue / Main Street was not detected; a hand pick disagreed with the fit and was dropped.
map, 100 ft. Church Street to Main Street, Railroad Avenue to Compton; public school, First M.E. Church.

sheet-4-1.description: The main part of sheet 4 covers eastern Belford between Church Street at the top and Main Street at the bottom, from Compton at the left edge to beyond Broadway, with Compton's Creek along the top right. It is drawn at 100 feet to an inch with north toward the upper right. Compton Cemetery lies on Church Street near the left edge, and Mary Jane and Thomas lead off Compton. Broadway runs straight from Church to Main through open land. Two railroad lines cross the sheet diagonally, and the R. S. Muchmore coal yard stands beside one of them at the left. South of the railroads, Lee Avenue, Palmer Avenue and East Road meet Main Street among a cluster of dwellings and stores, and low flooded land lies east of Broadway. Most of the area between Church and Main is vacant. An inset at the right, outlined by a heavy line and showing the Hotel Belford on Main Street, is a separate part.
notes: Placed from three junctions only (Church / Compton, Compton / Thomas, Broadway / Main); the fitted scale is about 3.5 percent larger than on sheets 2 and 3.
Palmer Avenue and Lee Avenue as drawn do not match the modern Palmer Street and Lee Avenue; they were not used.
map, 100 ft. Compton to Broadway, Church to Main; inset at right (part 2) with the Hotel Belford on Main Street, not placed. Fitted scale about 3.5 percent off the other sheets.
Not georeferenced on this sheet: inset: Hotel Belford on Main Street (one street only, location not identified; needs a parcel corner or a feature shared with another sheet).
